Termux mein chalao:

mkdir -p ~/.termux && echo "allow-external-apps=true" >> ~/.termux/termux.properties

phir Termux restart karo aur Your Friend ko "Run commands in Termux" permission do.

audio.cpp C library ke through OmniVoice app ke andar chalata hai. Android ke liye libaudiocpp.so build karo (docs/VOICE.md ya audiocpp-android workflow dekho), uski companion libraries ke saath import karo, phir GGUF model chuno.

Hugging Face token se ZeroGPU tumhare account ka roz ka quota use karta hai (login par zyada, PRO par aur zyada), aur private Space ke liye zaroori hai. Ye unlimited nahi hai. Soya hua Space jaagne mein 1–2 minute leta hai.

Hi, main %1$s hoon. Meri awaaz aisi hai.
Koi nahi — har sentence command hai

Comma se alag karo, jaise tanu, hey tanu, hi alex. Sirf wahi sentence jayega jisme inme se koi ho; command uske baad ki baat hai. Sirf wake word bolo to request ke liye 8 second milte hain. Recognizer jo spelling likhta hai wo bhi daalo (jaise তনু ya तनु).
